name: rijita-by-aryafoods
description: Premium Ecommerce Platform for RIJITA by Arya Foods

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client && npm run build:admin
scripts.install:all: cd frontend/client && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install && cd ../../server && npm install
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:server" "npm run start:client" "npm run start:admin"
